properties.name: OrderTicketsInfo
properties.description: 订单票务信息实体，封装完整的购票下单请求数据。包含14个字段：accountId(账户ID)、contactsId(联系人ID)、tripId(行程ID)、seatType(座位类型)、loginToken(登录令牌)、date(出发日期)、from(出发站)、to(到达站)、assurance(保险类型)、foodType(食物类型,默认0)、stationName/storeName/foodName/foodPrice(食物配送信息)、handleDate(处理日期)、consigneeName/consigneePhone/consigneeWeight(托运信息)、isWithin(是否区间内)。getFrom()和getTo()方法通过StringUtils.String2Lower将站名转为小写。被ts-preserve-service和ts-preserve-other-service等购票服务引用作为下单请求体。
properties.lifecycle: 作为购票下单的请求体在PreserveController和PreserveOtherController等中接收和传递，不持久化

properties.name: PreserveOtherController
properties.description: 其他类型列车(普通列车/K/Z字头)预定服务REST控制器。提供两个端点：welcome欢迎页和preserve购票预定接口(POST /preserveOther)。preserve方法接收OrderTicketsInfo请求体(含账户信息、行程车次、座位类型、保险、食物配送和托运信息)，记录购票日志(from站/to站/日期)后委托PreserveOtherService.preserve()执行完整的购票预定流程(安全检查、座位分配、订单创建、保险添加、通知发送等)，返回统一Response。
endpoints: POST /api/v1/preserveotherservice/preserveOther - 普通列车购票预定
properties.lifecycle: Spring @RestController，随ts-preserve-other-service启动注册

properties.name: PreserveOtherService

properties.name: VerifyCodeController
properties.description: 验证码服务REST控制器，提供图形验证码生成和验证两个核心接口。imageCode生成包含随机4位字符的JPEG图片验证码并写入HttpServletResponse输出流；verifyCode接收用户提交的验证码字符串，委托VerifyCodeService进行校验并记录日志。注意：verifyCode方法存在Bug，无论验证结果如何始终返回true。
endpoints: GET /api/v1/verifycode/generate - 生成图形验证码并输出JPEG图片
properties.lifecycle: Spring @RestController，随服务启动注册，处理验证码生成和校验请求

properties.name: VerifyCodeService
properties.description: 验证码服务核心接口，定义图形验证码生成和校验两个方法。getImageCode接收宽高参数和HTTP上下文生成验证码图片及对应字符；verifyCode根据请求中的Cookie和用户提交的验证码进行比对校验。
methods: getImageCode(int, int, OutputStream, HttpServletRequest, HttpServletResponse, HttpHeaders) -> Map<String, Object>
properties.lifecycle: Service接口，由VerifyCodeServiceImpl实现

properties.name: VerifyCodeServiceImpl
properties.description: 验证码服务实现类(152行)，实现VerifyCodeService接口。getImageCode方法使用Java AWT Graphics绘制含噪点干扰线的彩色验证码图片(4位随机大写字母数字组合)，通过CookieUtil管理客户端Cookie标识，使用Guava Cache(最大容量1000，过期时间1000秒)存储验证码值；verifyCode方法从请求Cookie提取标识后在缓存中查找对应验证码并进行忽略大小写的比对。包含静态辅助方法getRandColor生成随机颜色。
fields: cacheCode:Cache<String, String> - Guava Cache，最大容量1000，过期时间1000秒
methods: getImageCode(int, int, OutputStream, HttpServletRequest, HttpServletResponse, HttpHeaders) -> Map<String, Object>
getRandColor(int, int) -> Color (static) - 生成随机颜色
dependencies: Guava Cache - 验证码缓存存储
properties.lifecycle: Spring @Service单例Bean，常驻内存直到服务停止

properties.name: CookieUtil
properties.description: Cookie工具类(44行)，提供静态方法进行Cookie的读取和写入操作。addCookie创建新Cookie并设置httpOnly属性(防止XSS攻击)、path为根路径和maxAge过期时间后添加到响应；getCookieByName从请求中读取Cookie映射表查找指定名称的Cookie；readCookieMap遍历request.getCookies()构建名称到Cookie的HashMap。私有构造函数防止实例化。
methods: addCookie(HttpServletResponse, String, String, int) -> void (static) - 添加Cookie到响应，设置httpOnly和path
getCookieByName(HttpServletRequest, String) -> Cookie (static) - 按名称获取Cookie
readCookieMap(HttpServletRequest) -> Map<String, Cookie> (private static) - 遍历Cookie数组构建Map
properties.lifecycle: 静态工具类，不实例化，由VerifyCodeServiceImpl调用

testMethods: testImageCode - 测试生成验证码接口

properties.name: app
properties.description: ts-ticket-office-service应用入口文件(53行)，基于Express框架搭建的火车票代售点管理Web服务。配置favicon、morgan日志、body-parser(JSON和URL编码)、cookie-parser和静态文件中间件。启动时通过db.initMysql初始化MySQL数据库并建表。将router挂载到'/office'路径下。包含404错误处理和有条件错误堆栈显示的全局错误处理器。
properties.lifecycle: Node.js服务启动时执行，初始化数据库并启动HTTP监听

properties.name: db
properties.description: ts-ticket-office-service数据库模块(152行)，封装MySQL数据库连接和CRUD操作。数据库连接参数从环境变量读取(TICKET_OFFICE_MYSQL_HOST/PORT/USER/PASSWORD/DATABASE)。提供6个导出方法：initMysql(建表和初始化数据)、getAll(查询所有代售点)、getSpecificOffices(按省市区域查询代售点)、addOffice(新增代售点)、deleteOffice(按名称省市区域删除)、updateOffice(按名称省市区域更新)。注意存在SQL注入风险：getSpecificOffices、deleteOffice、updateOffice和insertEntry中直接拼接SQL字符串。
tables: office(name, city, province, region, address, workTime, windowNum) - 代售点信息表
exportedMethods: initMysql(callback) - 连接数据库并执行建表和数据初始化
getAll(callback) - 查询所有代售点记录
getSpecificOffices(province, city, region, callback) - 按省市区域查询代售点
addOffice(province, city, region, office, callback) - 新增代售点
deleteOffice(province, city, region, officeName, callback) - 删除指定代售点
updateOffice(province, city, region, oldOfficeName, newOffice, callback) - 更新代售点信息
internalFunctions: initData(callback) - CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS + 插入初始数据(金桥路代售点)
getSpecificOffices(province, city, region, db, callback) - SELECT * WHERE province.city.region
addOffice(province, city, region, office, db, callback) - INSERT INTO office
deleteOffice(province, city, region, officeName, db, callback) - DELETE FROM office WHERE
updateOffice(province, city, region, oldOfficeName, newOffice, db, callback) - UPDATE office SET
insertEntry(name, city, province, region, address, workTime, windowNum) - INSERT INTO office VALUES
securityIssues: SQL注入风险：多个查询方法直接拼接SQL字符串(如WHERE province = '" + province + "')
properties.lifecycle: 模块加载时创建MySQL连接，通过initMysql连接到数据库后执行初始化

properties.name: router
properties.description: ts-ticket-office-service路由模块(75行)，基于Express.Router定义代售点管理的RESTful API。提供7个路由端点：欢迎页(GET /)、获取区域列表(读取region.json文件)、查询所有代售点、按省市区域查询代售点、新增代售点、按名称区域删除代售点、按名称区域更新代售点。所有数据操作路由通过db模块执行数据库查询，返回JSON格式响应(MIME:text/json)。注意：同一区域不允许存在两个同名的代售点。
endpoints: GET /office/ - 欢迎页，返回欢迎信息
GET /office/getRegionList - 读取region.json返回区域列表
POST /office/getSpecificOffices - 按省市区查询代售点(body: {province, city, region})
POST /office/addOffice - 新增代售点(body: {province, city, region, office:{name,address,workTime,windowNum}})
POST /office/deleteOffice - 删除代售点(body: {province, city, region, officeName})
POST /office/updateOffice - 更新代售点(body: {province, city, region, oldOfficeName, newOffice:{name,address,workTime,windowNum}})
properties.lifecycle: 随Express应用启动由app.js加载并挂载到/office路径

nodes.label: AggregateAllCases
nodes.description: Java class that aggregates all per-case aggregated trace files into a single 'AllCasesResult.txt' file. Reads each case directory's 'all.txt', concatenates the content. Part of the Zipkin-to-ShiViz trace translation toolset for microservice fault analysis.

nodes.label: AggregateEachCase
nodes.description: Java class that aggregates trace files within each test case directory (case1, case2, ...) and each sub-directory (fail1, fail2, ...). Merges all .txt files into a single 'all.txt' per case directory for ShiViz visualization.

nodes.label: App (Json2Shiviz Entry)
nodes.description: Simple boilerplate Java application class generated by Gradle init task. Contains a getGreeting() method returning 'Hello world.'. The main method is commented out.

nodes.label: CalculateEventAndNode
nodes.description: Java analysis tool that parses aggregated ShiViz trace log files to count events and extract unique node identifiers. Uses regex patterns: patternEvent matches '{traceId=...spanId=...event=...}' format, patternNode extracts host names. Outputs event count and unique node count.

nodes.label: CallAnalysis (Fault Localization)
nodes.description: Java fault localization tool implementing spectrum-based fault localization (Ochiai metric). Parses Zipkin JSON traces, extracts service API call sequences, categorizes traces as failed/success, calculates suspiciousness score for each API using NCF/sqrt(NF*(NCF+NCS)) formula, and ranks APIs by suspiciousness. Uses org.json library.

nodes.label: Clock (Vector Clock Model)
nodes.description: Java model class representing a vector clock entry for microservice trace events. Stores type (cs/sr/ss/cr), host, src, traceId, spanId, parentId, and a HashMap-based vector clock. Provides isSrc() method to check if a clock entry is the source for a given trace event (matching by traceId, spanId/parentId, and type transition: cs->sr or ss->cr).

nodes.label: Span (Trace Span Model)
nodes.description: Java model class for a distributed tracing span. Holds traceId, spanId, parentId, spanname, child span IDs list, and a list of log entries (HashMap<String,String>). Supports adding child spans and log entries. Building block for the tree-structured trace representation.

nodes.label: Test (Regex Pattern Test)
nodes.description: Test class for regex pattern matching on trace event entries. Tests extracting host names from ShiViz-formatted trace entries like '{traceId=..., spanId=..., hostName=ts-order-service, ...}'. Also contains a getTestCaseDirList utility method.

nodes.label: TraceTranslator (Zipkin-to-ShiViz)
nodes.description: Core Java tool (1226 lines) that translates Zipkin JSON trace data into ShiViz-compatible text format for distributed system debugging visualization. Parses Zipkin spans (annotations: cs/sr/ss/cr, binary annotations: controller class/method, spring instance_id, error, state), builds tree-structured span hierarchy (using Span and Clock models), applies vector clock algorithm (clock2 method), sorts by causal order (sortLog, traverse, mergeForwardAndBackwardLogs), and writes ShiViz-formatted output files per test case. Handles both HTTP and message-based (queue) spans. Uses org.json library for JSON parsing.

nodes.label: TraceTranslatorQueue (Commented Out)
nodes.description: Entirely commented-out variant of TraceTranslator (1018 lines as comments). Represents an earlier/alternative implementation for handling message queue-based traces with slightly different clock and span-sorting logic. Contains inside_payment.async type handling. The entire source is commented out, suggesting it was replaced by the main TraceTranslator implementation.

nodes.label: AppTest
nodes.description: JUnit test class for the Json2Shiviz App class. Generated by Gradle init for unit testing.

nodes.label: @ContinueSpan Annotation
nodes.description: Java annotation (@Retention RUNTIME, @Inherited, @Target METHOD/TYPE) for marking methods or types that should continue an existing distributed tracing span rather than creating a new one. Part of the Sleuth-compatible microservice monitoring library.

nodes.label: @NewSpan Annotation
nodes.description: Java annotation for creating a new distributed tracing span. @AliasFor allows 'name' and 'value' to be used interchangeably. Applied to methods or types to mark the start of a new trace span. Part of the Sleuth-compatible microservice monitoring library.

nodes.label: NoOpTagValueResolver
nodes.description: No-op implementation of TagValueResolver interface. Returns null for all tag value resolutions. Part of the Sleuth-compatible monitoring annotation library.

nodes.label: SleuthAnnotatedParameter
nodes.description: Model class holding a method parameter index, its @SpanTag annotation, and the argument value. Used to extract span tag values from annotated method parameters.

nodes.label: SleuthAnnotationProperties
nodes.description: Spring Boot @ConfigurationProperties class for Sleuth annotation settings. Configures properties under the Sleuth annotations namespace.

nodes.label: SleuthAnnotationUtils
nodes.description: Package-private utility class for finding @NewSpan and @ContinueSpan annotations on methods. Checks method-level and class-level annotations. Extracts @SpanTag annotated parameters from method arguments. Uses Spring AnnotationUtils for annotation discovery with fallback method search.

nodes.label: @SpanTag Annotation
nodes.description: Java annotation for adding custom key-value tags to spans from method parameters. Supports both a TagValueResolver and a SpEL expression for dynamic tag value resolution. The 'key' field names the tag, 'resolver' specifies the resolver class, and 'expression' provides a SpEL expression.

nodes.label: SpelTagValueExpressionResolver
nodes.description: Implementation that resolves span tag values using Spring Expression Language (SpEL). Parses and evaluates SpEL expressions against the parameter object to produce tag values for distributed tracing spans.

nodes.label: TagValueExpressionResolver Interface
nodes.description: Interface for resolving span tag values from expressions. Defines the contract for expression-based tag value resolution in the Sleuth monitoring library.

nodes.label: TagValueResolver Interface
nodes.description: Interface for resolving span tag values from method parameter values. Provides the base contract for custom tag value resolution strategies in distributed tracing.

nodes.label: SleuthProperties
nodes.description: Spring Boot @ConfigurationProperties class holding Sleuth distributed tracing configuration. Top-level properties class for spring.sleuth namespace configuration.

nodes.label: TraceEnvironmentPostProcessor
nodes.description: Spring EnvironmentPostProcessor that sets default logging pattern to include distributed tracing IDs (X-B3-TraceId, X-B3-SpanId, X-Span-Export) in log output. Configures logging.pattern.level with trace context placeholders and sets spring.aop.proxyTargetClass=true. Applies these defaults early in the Spring lifecycle.

nodes.label: EBPProc (Executor Bean Post Processor)
nodes.description: Spring BeanPostProcessor that wraps Executor beans (excluding ThreadPoolTaskExecutor) with tracing-aware proxies. Creates CGLIB/JDK proxies with ExecutorMethodInterceptor to propagate trace context into async tasks using LTExec wrapper. Ensures distributed tracing spans carry over async boundaries.

nodes.label: LTACus (Lazy Trace Async Configurer)
nodes.description: Spring AsyncConfigurer implementation that wraps the async executor with an LTExec (Lazy Trace Executor) to propagate trace context in @Async methods. Extends AsyncConfigurerSupport for default exception handler support.

nodes.label: TMHead (Trace Message Head)
nodes.description: Model class for message tracing headers. Holds trace context information to be propagated through messaging systems for distributed tracing across message queues.

nodes.label: SSProp (Sleuth Scheduler Properties)
nodes.description: Spring Boot @ConfigurationProperties class for Sleuth scheduler instrumentation settings under spring.sleuth.scheduler namespace.

nodes.label: SWCEnable (Sleuth Web Client Enable Condition)
nodes.description: Conditional configuration for enabling Sleuth web client instrumentation. Uses @ConditionalOnProperty for conditional bean registration based on spring.sleuth.web.client.enabled property.

nodes.label: THResp (Trace HTTP Response)
nodes.description: Decorator/wrapper around Spring ClientHttpResponse that notifies the trace interceptor (TRTInter) on response close. Delegates all HTTP response methods (getHeaders, getBody, getStatusCode, getRawStatusCode, getStatusText) to the underlying response and calls interceptor.finish() in close(). Ensures trace span completion for HTTP client calls.

nodes.label: ServletUtils
nodes.description: Utility class for servlet-related operations. Works with HttpServletRequest and HttpServletResponse for web request tracing.

nodes.label: SWProp (Sleuth Web Properties)
nodes.description: Spring Boot @ConfigurationProperties class for Sleuth web instrumentation under spring.sleuth.web namespace. Configures: enabled (default true), skipPattern (URL patterns to exclude from tracing: health endpoints, swagger, static resources .png/.css/.js/.html), client settings, and async client template settings. Nested classes: Client, Async, AsyncClient, Template.

nodes.label: TRAttr (Trace Attributes)
nodes.description: Constants or model class for trace attribute names used in web request tracing. Holds attribute keys for storing trace context in HTTP request attributes.

nodes.label: TSDBPProcess (Trace Spring Data Bean Post Processor)
nodes.description: Spring BeanPostProcessor that wraps DelegatingHandlerMapping beans with a tracing-aware TraceDelegatingHandlerMapping. The inner class TraceDelegatingHandlerMapping extends DelegatingHandlerMapping and adds a THInter (Trace Handler Interceptor) to each handler execution chain. Enables automatic trace context propagation for Spring MVC handler mappings.

nodes.label: TWMConf (Trace Web MVC Configuration)
nodes.description: Spring @Configuration class extending WebMvcConfigurerAdapter. Registers THInter (Trace Handler Interceptor) as a Spring MVC interceptor and provides a @Bean for it. Enables automatic distributed tracing for all incoming HTTP requests by adding the trace interceptor to the Spring MVC interceptor registry.

nodes.label: ItemContext Interface
nodes.description: Interface representing a tracing item context in the Sleuth-compatible monitoring library. Works with Map data structure for storing span context information.

nodes.label: @ItemName Annotation
nodes.description: Java @Documented annotation for naming a tracing item/span. Can be applied to methods or types to provide a custom name for the span in distributed tracing.

nodes.label: LogAtcfg (Logging Auto-Configuration)
nodes.description: Spring auto-configuration class for Sleuth logging integration. Conditionally (spring.sleuth.enabled=true, default) configures: Slf4jItemLogger when SLF4J MDC is available (sets up MDC entries for X-B3-TraceId, X-B3-SpanId) or NoItemLogger when slf4j is disabled or MDC class is not on classpath. Provides skip-pattern support via Slf4jProps.

nodes.label: Slf4jProps (SLF4J Logging Properties)
nodes.description: Spring Boot @ConfigurationProperties class for SLF4J logging integration settings under spring.sleuth.log.slf4j namespace. Configures the name skip pattern for controlling which spans are logged.

nodes.label: ChainMetricsAtcfg (Metrics Auto-Configuration)
nodes.description: Spring auto-configuration class for Sleuth metrics/chaining integration. Conditionally configures span metric reporting using Spring Boot Actuator CounterService. Complex conditional bean registration based on classpath availability of metrics libraries.

nodes.label: CSBSMRep (Counter Service Based Span Metric Reporter)
nodes.description: Implementation of ItemMetricReporter using Spring Boot Actuator CounterService. Reports span metrics (counts) via CounterService for monitoring and alerting. Each span name gets a counter that can be queried via Actuator metrics endpoints.

nodes.label: ItemMetricReporter Interface
nodes.description: Interface for reporting span/item metrics in the Sleuth monitoring library. Contract for span metric reporting implementations.

nodes.label: NOIMRep (No-Op Item Metric Reporter)
nodes.description: No-op implementation of ItemMetricReporter. Used when metrics reporting is disabled or metrics libraries are unavailable on classpath.

nodes.label: SMProp (Sleuth Metrics Properties)
nodes.description: Spring Boot @ConfigurationProperties class for Sleuth metrics configuration under spring.sleuth.metrics namespace.

nodes.label: SProps (Sleuth Sampler Properties)
nodes.description: Spring Boot @ConfigurationProperties class for Sleuth trace sampling configuration under spring.sleuth.sampler namespace. Controls trace sampling rate and strategy.

nodes.label: StateItemAdjuster Interface
nodes.description: Interface for adjusting the state of a tracing item/span. Provides hooks for modifying span state during the tracing lifecycle in the Sleuth-compatible library.

nodes.label: TestFlowOne (End-to-End Ticket Booking Flow)
nodes.description: Selenium WebDriver end-to-end test for the complete ticket booking flow (Flow One). Error handling: 400 for missing/invalid image, 500 for processing exceptions. Runs in debug mode on host 0.0.0.0.

nodes.label: base64toimage Utility

Used as a standalone image conversion utility.

nodes.label: Face Detection Module
nodes.description: Python face detection module using dlib's HOG-based frontal face detector. The check(img) function: 1) Detects faces using dlib.get_frontal_face_detector(), 2) If no faces found, returns {'msg': 'no human face found'}, 3) For each detected face, extracts the face region from the image, saves to ./images/img_face_N.jpg, 4) Encodes the cropped face as base64 string (JPEG format) and returns it. Returns base64_str on success or error dict on failure.

tour.title: API 网关入口 (Spring Cloud Gateway)
tour.description: Train Ticket 系统的统一入口，基于 Spring Cloud Gateway 反应式网关构建。GatewayApplication 为 Spring Boot 启动类，启用服务发现与负载均衡；GatewayConfiguration 集成 Alibaba Sentinel 实现限流熔断，对管理端点施加 QPS 限制；application.yml 定义了全部 40+ 微服务的路由规则（predicates/filters），包括对 ts-ui-dashboard 前端静态资源及后端 API 的代理转发。这是理解整个系统请求流转的最佳起点。

tour.title: 认证与授权服务 (ts-auth-service)
tour.description: 用户认证与授权的核心微服务。AuthApplication 启动类注册 Eureka 客户端并启用 Swagger 文档；TokenServiceImpl 负责 JWT Token 的签发、验证与刷新，所有下游服务均依赖 Token 做身份校验；UserServiceImpl 管理用户注册、登录、信息查询；WebSecurityConfig 配置 Spring Security 过滤器链和密码编码器，定义哪些端点需要认证、哪些可匿名访问。这是理解系统安全体系的关键模块。

tour.title: 共享实体库与公共组件 (ts-common)
tour.description: 所有微服务依赖的公共模块（Maven 坐标 edu.fudan.common）。pom.xml 聚合了 Lombok、Jackson、Spring Security、JWT（JJWT）等跨服务共享依赖；JWTUtil 从 HTTP Authorization Bearer 头中解析并校验 JWT Token，构建 Spring Security Authentication 对象，是各服务验证用户身份的通用工具；Trip 实体定义了一次火车行程的核心数据结构（车次、路线、站点、时间），被 travel、order、preserve 等多个服务引用。此外还包含 20+ 实体（Account、Order、Ticket、Seat 等）、枚举（Type 列车类型、Gender 性别）、异常（BaseException、TokenException）和 Swagger 配置。

tour.title: 列车行程服务 (ts-travel-service & ts-travel2-service)
tour.description: 两套独立的行程服务分别管理高铁/动车（G/D 字头）和普通列车（Z/T/K 字头）的行程数据。TravelController 提供 11 个 REST 端点：行程 CRUD、按车次类型查询、路线查询、余票查询、行程全量管理等；Travel2Controller 提供 10 个类似端点，覆盖普通列车的对应功能；InitData 在应用启动时通过 CommandLineRunner 预载 5 条示例行程，确保开发与演示环境有可用数据。TravelServiceImpl 与 Travel2ServiceImpl 共享接口设计，体现微服务中「按领域拆分、保持接口一致」的实践模式。

tour.title: 出行规划服务 (ts-travel-plan-service)
tour.description: 实现多维度出行方案查询的编排服务。TravelPlanController 暴露 5 个端点：首页、中转搜索、最便宜路线、最快路线、最少停站路线；TravelPlanServiceImpl 是核心编排逻辑——中转搜索同时调用 ts-travel-service（高铁）和 ts-travel2-service（普速），聚合两段式行程结果（TransferTravelResult）；最便宜/最快/最少停站查询则先调用 ts-route-plan-service 获取最优路线，再调用 price 和 seat 服务填充票价与余票信息。这是跨服务编排模式的典型示例。

tour.title: 订单服务 (ts-order-service)
tour.description: 管理订票全生命周期的核心服务。OrderApplication 注册负载均衡 RestTemplate，通过服务名调用下游微服务；OrderServiceImpl 负责订单创建、状态流转（已预订-已支付-已使用/已取消）、订单查询、订单改签触发等核心业务逻辑；pom.xml 引入 JPA 与 MySQL 驱动，订单数据持久化到关系数据库。该服务通过 RestTemplate 协调 seat（座位分配）、price（票价计算）、payment（支付）、notification（通知）等多个下游服务，是典型的微服务协调者模式。

tour.title: 预约与改签服务 (ts-preserve-service & ts-rebook-service)
tour.description: 处理候补购票与订单改签的业务模块。PreserveApplication 启用异步与 Swagger，PreserveServiceImpl 实现候补下单、预约查询、预约取消等功能，通过 Queues 配置 RabbitMQ 消息队列实现异步候补处理；RebookServiceImpl 实现改签核心逻辑——订单验证、时间检查、座位重分配、差价计算，并跨服务调用 order、seat、payment、travel 等多个微服务完成改签事务。这两个服务共同构成了「购票-候补-改签-退票」完整票务流程的关键环节。

tour.title: 领域支撑服务集群 (Route / Seat / Station / Train)
tour.description: 四个基础领域服务为上层业务提供数据支撑。RouteApplication 管理列车线路信息（站点序列、距离、耗时），是票价计算和行程规划的数据源；SeatApplication 维护座位库存，提供座位查询、分配与释放功能，与 SoldTicket 实体配合追踪已售票数量；StationServiceImpl 提供车站基础信息的 CRUD 查询；TrainServiceImpl 管理列车类型、编组、席位配置等元数据。这些服务不直接面向前端，而是通过 travel、order、preserve 等业务服务间接被调用，体现了分层微服务架构。

tour.title: 多语言微服务实践 (Go / Node.js / Python)
tour.description: Train Ticket 在统一的 Spring Cloud 体系之外，展示了多语言微服务如何接入同一系统。ts-news-service（Go 语言）使用 github.com/hoisie/web 轻量框架，监听 :12862 端口，通过静态 JSON 返回新闻资讯，展示了 Go 服务如何通过 HTTP 融入 Java 为主的微服务集群；ts-ticket-office-service（Node.js Express）提供售票网点查询功能，package.json 定义其依赖与脚本；ts-avatar-service（Python Flask + OpenCV + dlib）提供用户头像上传与人脸检测功能，使用 Gunicorn 作为 WSGI 服务器。这三个服务通过网关的统一路由规则被前端透明访问，展示了异构技术栈下的服务治理模式。

tour.title: CI/CD 与容器化运维基础设施 (Jenkins + K8s + 链路追踪)
tour.description: 系统的持续集成与部署基础设施。jenkins-ci/Jenkinsfile 定义了 CI 流水线的构建、测试、打包、镜像构建与推送流程；old-docs/k8s/ 目录下包含完整的 Kubernetes 部署清单（ts-deployment-part1/2/3.yml），覆盖数据库（MongoDB、MySQL）、中间件（RabbitMQ）和全部微服务的 Deployment 与 Service 定义，配合 Istio VirtualService 实现灰度发布和故障注入实验；ms-monitoring-core 是仿 Spring Cloud Sleuth 的自研链路追踪库，TraceAutoConfiguration 为装配入口，Item 定义兼容 Zipkin 格式的 Span 模型（含 TraceId/SpanId/ParentId/CS/CR/SR/SS 注解），ChainCallable/ChainRunnable 将追踪上下文传播到异步线程，确保跨 40+ 微服务的请求链路可完整追踪。
